title: Incorrect header name normalization
detail: The code attempts to normalize header names to 'Content-Type' if they are not already in lowercase. This can lead to incorrect behavior if a header other than 'Content-Type' is provided, as it will be overwritten.
note: headers other than Content-Type get overwritten

title: Assumes 'Content-Type' header is always present
detail: The code assumes that the 'Content-Type' header is always present in self.headers, which may not be the case, leading to a KeyError.
